exam_description:
Official IELC IELTS General Training Placement Test covering 4 core modules:

  • Listening: 4 sections, 40 questions (30 mins)
  • Reading: 3 sections, 40 questions (60 mins)
  • Writing: Task 1 Letter & Task 2 Essay (60 mins, 400+ words total)
  • Speaking: 1-on-1 live interview with a certified examiner (11–14 mins)

Total duration: 150 minutes.

tasks.title: IELTS General Training Listening Section (4 Sections, 40 Questions)
tasks.description:
The IELTS® Listening Section is designed to measure your ability to understand conversations and lectures in English.

  • There are 4 sections in the Listening test (40 Questions in total).
  • The test duration is approximately 30 minutes under real test conditions.
  • Listen carefully, as the audio track will be played only once.
  • Follow the question booklet on the left and enter your answers in the digital answer sheet (1–40) on the right.

tasks.title: IELTS General Training Reading Section (3 Sections, 40 Questions)
tasks.description:
The IELTS® General Training Reading Section measures your ability to understand everyday practical materials, work-related notices, and general interest texts.

  • There are 3 Reading Sections / Passages in this test (40 Questions in total).
  • The test duration is 60 minutes.
  • Read the passages and instructions in the booklet on the left and enter your answers into the digital answer sheet (1–40) on the right.
  • Pay attention to word count limits in the instructions (e.g. NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER, TRUE/FALSE/NOT GIVEN).

tasks.title: IELTS General Training Writing Task 1 (Letter Writing)
tasks.description:
Task 1: Formal / Semi-formal Letter

You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

Prompt: Your local hospital has advertised for people to do unpaid work helping at the hospital. You would like to do some work at the hospital in your free time.

Write a letter to the hospital. In your letter:

  • Explain why you would like to do unpaid work at the hospital
  • Say what type of unpaid work at the hospital you would prefer
  • Give details of when you would be available for this work

You do NOT need to write any addresses. Begin your letter as follows: Dear Sir or Madam,

Requirements:

  • Write in a formal style.
  • Write at least 150 words.
  • Type your letter directly in the text editor on the right.

tasks.title: IELTS General Training Writing Task 2 (Discursive Essay)
tasks.description:
Task 2: Discursive Essay

You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

Topic: It is sometimes said that people should be encouraged to get married before they are 30, as this is best both for the individual and for society. Do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

Requirements:

  • Write in a formal style.
  • Write at least 250 words.
  • Type your essay directly in the text editor on the right, or upload your document.

tasks.title: IELTS Speaking Interview & Discussion
tasks.description:
The IELTS® Speaking Section is designed to measure your ability to speak English effectively in both academic and general settings.

In the Speaking test, you will have a 1-on-1 interactive discussion with an experienced certified examiner. The test is approximately 11–14 minutes long and divided into 3 parts:

  1. Part 1 (Introduction & Interview): You will answer questions about yourself, your hobbies, studies/work, and everyday topics.
  2. Part 2 (Individual Long Turn): You will be given a topic card with 1 minute to prepare, and speak for 1–2 minutes.
  3. Part 3 (Two-way Discussion): A deeper discussion with the examiner exploring abstract issues related to Part 2.

ℹ️ The speaking test will be conducted live online with one of our experienced certified examiners during your scheduled consultation appointment. See you there!
